newsitem.title: USA: Harmat to acquire Spa Faucet.
newsitem.headline: Harmat to acquire Spa Faucet.

text.p: The Harmat Organization said Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Spa Faucet Inc in a stock transaction.
Under the proposed deal, each Spa Faucet shareholder will receive one preferred share of Harmat for every six Spa Faucet common shares held.
Each preferred share is convertible into two warrants, each entitling the holder to buy one Harmat common share, provided Spa Faucet meets certain earnings thresholds, it said.

The preferred shares and warrants are convertible after 25 months from the date of the exchange. Until the preferred shares are converted, their holders have the right to cast two ballots per preferred share on any matters brought before shareholders for a vote.
Harmat said the transaction is subject to the approval of Spa Faucet shareholders.
